title: Chef John's Zabaglione
description: In this classic Italian dessert, sweet, juicy fruit is enveloped in a rich but impossibly light custard.
ingredients: 0.5 cup strawberries - hulled, halved and sliced

steps.text: Gently stir the strawberries and sugar together in a bowl. Cover and let sit at room temperature until juices release, about 1 hour.
Divide fruit between 2 small, clear serving bowls or stemmed cocktail glasses.

Place egg yolks, sugar, and marsala into metal mixing bowl. Set over burner on low heat. Hold rim of bowl with a potholder. Whisk until mixture forms loose peaks, 7 or 8 minutes. Mixture should feel warm to the touch.
Spoon custard over the strawberries. Serve while custard is still warm.

video.description: Fresh strawberries in their own juices are topped with a light and sweet marsala wine cream. What could be better? At once one of the easiest desserts with which you will impress your sweetheart, the zabaglione’s is smooth, luscious and just terrifically delicious. Add a little brulee caramelizing with a kitchen torch for an exciting finish. They’ll love it (and you)!
